{{Top|leg}}
The '''Crying Room''' was a cellar far below [[Château Malreaux]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]]. It had lifelike roses and thorns carved into the wall. It was used by the Viscount's wives to bemourn their own lives.

During [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda's]] [[Mission to Vjun (Clone Wars)|mission]] to Vjun, [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Whie Malreaux/Legends|Whie Malreaux]] and [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy|Scout]] found themselves captured by [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] in the room. Ventress tried to turn Whie to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] but was unsuccessful. She was about to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Padawans when they were rescued by the timely arrival of [[Solis]], a [[Tac-Spec Corporation|Tac-Spec]] [[FIII Footman droid]] who held a grudge against Ventress.
